datasets.representative_proof: This frozen population has counts 6s/2s/s/s with s>=1 and pairwise Hamming distances 1,2,10 / 1,9 / 8. For any positive repetition m, the same two edges hold: 6ms>=2(2ms)-1 and 2ms>=2(ms)-1; both reverse inequalities remain false, and the distance-10 UMI stays isolated. This is specific to this population, not a general invariance of directional clustering. Copies of each unique highest-MAPQ representative are identical; the independent expected representative set therefore remains unchanged.
